reviews.comment: He's a great prof who loves to answer questions and explain things in a straightforward manner. He's super cheerful and tries his best to make himself available for questions. The final is notoriously difficult, but the quizzes and homework were all pretty easy with him.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great prof and lenient grader that managed to make 8 am's enjoyable. Quizzes and homeworks aren't very hard and you get multiple tries for homeworks. Final exam will man handle you if you don't study.
Great professor for PHYS 216. Helped me with homework when I asked him and was very accommodating during class lectures (provided question examples and answered questions in class).

He's a great prof, but I just didn't learn the way he taught. I didn't really feel comfortable asking questions, but I know other people were. The class is very dependent on group work, so if you get stuck with a bad one then expect to carry. It would help so so much to have prior coding experience too.

One of the funniest professors I've had! Super engaging and knowledgeable, he made the class enjoyable and easy to follow. His sense of humor added a unique touch to the lectures, making them both informative and entertaining. His ability to engage his students through humor made the early morning lectures more bearable. Highly recommend!

He is a great prof and I highly advise to get work done ahead because it can pile up. The tests are tough but managable through alot of studying. The class goes somewhat fast so make sure to stay of top of the coursework.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class was very lecture heavy. The TAS didn't do much to help and I'm thankful I came in with moderate coding experience or this class would be very difficult for me as it was for many others. I don't blame this on the professor but make sure you learn some basics in coding so you aren't fumbling through the class. VERY groupwork heavy.
102 is not a fun class but Elizondo made it so much better, he is also very helpful in office hours and is always willing to help. If you can take him do so because he will you a lot.

He's a very excellent professor and really helped expand my knowledge of Python through his lectures. Zybooks also helped cement my understanding for the quizzes, homework, and exams in the class. I really like how he does Quizziz to help us review for a quiz we had. Exams are hard, but his class along with doing the Zybooks prepared me well.

ENGR 102 is a very time consuming subject for new programmers. The lectures are quite informative and students learn a lot from them. He also provides many examples of what he is trying to teach. He gives two extra credit opportunities that I would recommend doing. Tests are quite hard though with no curve but that's an ENGR 102 thing.
An absolutely amazing teacher. Tough grader but would still recommend to any one of my friends. Is very good at conveying knowledge to students. Kinda funny too
He's a good professor that knows how to teach. Every concept is made clear by the examples he does in class. He is really good at answering questions and is pretty easily reachable.

I came into this class with no prior coding experience, but JP's lectures along with the ZyBooks helped expand my coding skill. His lectures are good, just be sure to be there. Don't be afraid to ask for help, him and his PT's are very helpful. Get ready to read and do the ZyBooks problems; they'll cement your understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super nice and caring guy, you can tell he knows the material and likes to teach it. Highly recomend
Bro this professor is a W. He is great at teaching and makes random funny comments from time to time. I would take him again and I will. So glad I took his class.

Jon is hilarious, and a really nice guy. He rushes through the lectures to give us more time to work on labs, and is very helpful when asked. The work is heavy and incredibly difficult- there are weekly quizzes and assignments due every couple days, and the exams are rough. However, Jon is an awesome professor and will get you through it!

Jon Elizondo is a very efficient and excellent prof. He is easily accessible outside of class and helps any student in need to the best of his ability. Because the lab portion of the class is 50%, make each lab report (6 total) count because the final (20%) was very difficult! If you need help with any ENGR or PHYS problem, he will assist you.

Elizondo is a great professor. He doesn't waste your time as his lectures are pretty short and he gives minimal homework. He's very accessible outside of class and is always willing to help out and check your work. The final was very difficult, as it was for every 216 student, but only makes up 20% of your grade so an A is still very achievable.

Dr. Elizondo was great for 216. He made the lectures short, which allowed us to go home early a lot of the times. He was quick to respond to emails and help out. He has a pretty dry sense of humor (which I appreciated).
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He is very chill and understanding. I had issues with homework submissions, and he was incredibly helpful sorting it out. Lectures are short and concise but understandable. The final is difficult, but if you attend class and pay attention throughout the semester then it's manageable. Homework is reasonable and not too long. 10/10, highly recommend.

Made this course manageable.Allowed students to vote on the structure of the course,ex: an hour lecture or half an hour of lecture and the rest of class time to ask questions/ do HW, the deadline of quizes.He's cool, open to questions, helpful, and concise.Had no idea what I was getting into when registering for him. Mad respect for the guy.
He's a pretty cool dude and does his best to not make the class too time consuming or difficult.
Cool guy, cares about students and always open to questions. Made lectures fun and entertaining and tries to help the students as much as possible.
amazing professor. great lectures, cares about you and friendly

He has short lectures that are very informative and then leaves the rest of class time for homework. He's young and well spoken. He's always willing to help explain if you have an issue. As long as you show up to class you can easily pass.
Lectures are really good for the most part, but after the lecture during coding his help was very confusing and not too helpful. His final exam grade was in the D range and there was no curve on that
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: lotta boring lectures if you know the stuff but good review. if you dont, all the information you need is given in a pretty concise format. a lot of things dont make sense because coding is a foreign concept, but youll understand it as time passes and each assignment is like a puzzle. cool class. super chill prof, fresh grad so he knows how it is

Elizondo is a cool guy. He's helpful with questions and is super open to rescheduling quizzes if you missed one. A lot of the complaints about 102 aren't controlled by professors - lots of homework, quizzes and group projects. His quizzes are hard but if you study for them with the slides he provides you will be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Clear grading criteria
